    id="updateMember"
    actionType="UPDATE_BY"
    changesetIsObject={true}

attributes.value:
{{ 'Welcome! This app is loaded with **sample data** so you can click around and explore right away.

When you are ready to wire up your real database, follow these steps:

1. 🔌 **Connect your database** — Go to *Resources* in Retool and add your DB
2. 🔄 **Update queries** — Open each query in the bottom panel and switch the Resource
3. 📝 **Update table/column names** — Edit the SQL in each query to match your schema
4. 🧹 **Remove mock data** — In each Table/Select, remove the mock array fallback from the data attribute
5. 🗑️ **Delete this modal** — Remove this Setup Guide and the setupGuideBtn button

✅ You are all set — happy building!' }}

When you are ready to wire up your real database, follow these steps:

✅ You are all set — happy building!' }}"
